stdout: (no config - demo: an invented three-variant ad test, planned and then read)
PLAN - conversions per impression
3 variants (2 comparisons with the control), alpha per comparison 0.0250
Needs 121,173 impressions per variant, 363,519 in all: about 7 days.
Fits inside 28 days. Run it to the planned size before reading it.
READ - conversions per impression
CUSTOMER QUOTE BEATS THE CONTROL: A 41% lift on conversions per impression (p < 0.0001, threshold 0.0250). Roll it out, and keep the control running on a small share to watch for decay.
Control - product screenshot: 0.198% (0.18% to 0.22%) on 124,000 - control, 15.12 per conversion
Customer quote: 0.279% (0.25% to 0.31%) on 123,500 - lift +41%, p < 0.0001 *, 10.74 per conversion
Price in the headline: 0.216% (0.19% to 0.24%) on 124,500 - lift +9%, p = 0.3326, 13.88 per conversion
FINDINGS
i  2 challengers were compared with the control, so each one had to clear p < 0.0250 (Bonferroni) rather than 0.05, to keep the chance of a false winner at 0.05 overall.
